units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=Prune unused Docker images
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker image prune -a -f --filter "until=24h"

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: docker-prune.service

units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=Run docker-prune.service weekly

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Sun *-*-* 04:00:00
# 負荷分散のため、実際の実行時間をずらすことを許可する
AccuracySec=2h
# 実行できなかった場合、次回起動時に実行する
Persistent=true

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
units.name: docker-prune.timer

units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=timezone settings

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=true
ExecStart=/bin/timedatectl set-timezone Asia/Tokyo

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: set-timezone.service

units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=run node-exporter container
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service

[Service]
Type=simple
Restart=always
RestartSec=30s
TimeoutStartSec=10min
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker pull prom/node-exporter
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker stop node_exporter
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker rm node_exporter
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --rm --name node_exporter\
  --network=host\
  --pid=host\
  -v /:/host:ro,rslave\
  prom/node-exporter --path.rootfs=/host

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: node-exporter.service

units.contents:
[Unit]
Description=run Grafana Alloy container
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service

[Service]
Type=simple
Restart=always
RestartSec=30s
TimeoutStartSec=10min
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker pull grafana/alloy:latest
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker stop alloy
ExecStartPre=-/usr/bin/docker rm alloy
ExecStart=/usr/bin/docker run --rm --name alloy \
  -v /home/flatcar/.alloy/config.alloy:/etc/alloy/config.alloy:ro \
  -v /var/log/journal:/var/log/journal:ro \
  -v /run/log/journal:/run/log/journal:ro \
  -v /etc/machine-id:/etc/machine-id:ro \
  -v /home/flatcar/.alloy/data:/var/lib/alloy/data \
  -p 127.0.0.1:12345:12345 \
  grafana/alloy:latest run \
  --server.http.listen-addr=0.0.0.0:12345 \
  --storage.path=/var/lib/alloy/data \
  /etc/alloy/config.alloy

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
units.name: alloy.service
